observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a large pile of used car engines and gearboxes in a cluttered, dusty storage area with pink walls.
Multiple engines are visible, some with green paint or markings, others bare metal.
One engine has a red and green circular sticker or label on its side.
The engines appear to be from different vehicles, with varying sizes and configurations.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on any engine in the photos.
The seller claims 'Direct belgium Honda engines and gear box' with a guarantee, plug and drive engines, tested and trusted.
The photos show no signs of recent testing or working condition; they appear used and possibly salvaged.
